{{Top|leg}}
The '''DA-series droid''' was an analysis [[Droid/Legends|droid]] developed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to be used as scavengers at battle sites. Under the direction of [[Operation Flotsam]] and the [[Historical Battle Site Preservation Act]], these droids were used to gather information from any recovered physical evidence from a battle site, prior to full public disclosure. These droids were often accompanied by the [[SM-series scavenger droid]]s, which collected the physical evidence for them.
